{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Confirm that 'completed' orders are those with status 'completed'
assert df['status'].nunique() == 2, "Expected exactly two status values"
assert 'completed' in df['status'].unique(), "'completed' status must exist"
assert 'refunded' in df['status'].unique(), "'refunded' status must exist"

# Confirm internal test orders have revenue = 999,999.99
internal_test_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999,999.99']
assert len(internal_test_rows) == 6, "Expected exactly 6 internal test orders"
assert (internal_test_rows['status'] == 'completed').all(), "All internal test orders should be marked as completed"

# Confirm revenue is stored as string with commas
assert df['revenue'].dtype == 'object', "Revenue should be string (object) type"
assert df['revenue'].str.contains(',').any(), "Revenue string should contain commas"

# Confirm no other internal test orders exist
other_test_values = df[~df['revenue'].isin(['0.00', '999,999.99'])]['revenue'].unique()
assert len(other_test_values) == 0, f"Unexpected revenue values: {other_test_values}"

# Now clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
df_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue:,.2f} USD")"}
